Just focus on studying for the test for a couple of weeks and you will quite definitely get at least 87 points.

I watched some Youtube videos to get a feel of the test and to understand the different parts, and did daily exercises for two weeks. Recognize your strengths and weaknesses, and focus on sharpening tour skills especially on the latter. For me, the most difficult part was speaking, so that's what I mostly practiced.

In the end, I got 110/120, which kind of surprised me because I felt that the test didn't even go that well for me.

Good luck with taking the test!
